008package paint.fiji.trackmate;
009
010import paint.ui.dialogs.ProjectDialog;
011import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
012import paint.shared.validate.ValidationResult;
013
014import java.nio.file.Files;
015import java.nio.file.Path;
016import java.time.Duration;
017import java.time.LocalDateTime;
018import java.util.List;
019
020import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV;
021import static paint.shared.utils.Miscellaneous.formatDuration;
022import static paint.shared.validate.ImageRootValidator.validateImageRoot;
023import static paint.shared.validate.ValidationHandler.validateExperiments;
024
025/**
026 * The {@code RunTrackMateOnProject} class orchestrates the TrackMate analysis
027 * across multiple experiments contained within a project directory.
028 * <p>
029 * It validates image directories and configuration files before processing,
030 * handles per-experiment execution, supports user-initiated cancellation, and
031 * logs all key events and outcomes.
032 * </p>
033 * <p>
034 * Each experiment is validated and processed independently, ensuring that a
035 * failure in one experiment does not halt others. At completion, a total
036 * runtime summary is logged.
037 * </p>
038 */
039public class RunTrackMateOnProject extends RunTrackMateOnExperiment {
040
041    /**
042     * Executes the TrackMate analysis pipeline for all specified experiments
043     * within the given project directory. Performs validation on both image
044     * roots and CSV metadata, then runs the core processing for each experiment.
045     *
046     * @param projectPath     the root directory of the Paint project containing experiment subfolders
047     * @param imagesPath      the directory containing image files for the experiments
048     * @param experimentNames list of experiment folder names to be processed
049     * @param dialog          optional {@link ProjectDialog} used for user-driven cancellation
050     * @param sweepDir        optional override directory for writing analysis results
051     *                        (defaults to {@code projectPath} if {@code null})
052     * @return {@code true} if all experiments processed successfully;
053     * {@code false} if any validation or runtime errors occurred
054     */
055    public static boolean runProject(Path projectPath,
056                                     Path imagesPath,
057                                     List<String> experimentNames,
058                                     ProjectDialog dialog,
059                                     Path sweepDir) {
060
061        boolean status = true;                               // Overall success flag
062        LocalDateTime start = LocalDateTime.now();           // Timestamp for runtime measurement
063
064        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
065        // Phase 1 – Validate that required images exist
066        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
067        ValidationResult validateResult = validateImageRoot(projectPath, imagesPath, experimentNames);
068        if (!validateResult.isValid()) {
069            for (String err : validateResult.getErrors()) {
070                PaintLogger.errorf(err);
071            }
072            return false;   // Abort on image validation failure
073        }
074
075        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
076        // Phase 2 – Validate experiment configuration (Experiment Info.csv)
077        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
078        validateResult = validateExperiments(projectPath, experimentNames, EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV);
079        if (!validateResult.isValid()) {
080            for (String err : validateResult.getErrors()) {
081                PaintLogger.errorf(err);
082            }
083            return false;                                   // Abort on configuration validation failure
084        }
085
086        PaintLogger.debugf("RunTrackMateOnProject.runProject - Project path: %s", projectPath);
087        PaintLogger.debugf("RunTrackMateOnProject.runProject - Images root:  %s", imagesPath);
088        PaintLogger.debugf("RunTrackMateOnProject.runProject - Experiments:  %s", experimentNames);
089
090        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
091        // Phase 3 – Execute TrackMate per experiment
092        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
093        for (String experimentName : experimentNames) {
094            // Allow user to cancel processing mid-run
095            if (dialog != null && dialog.isCancelled()) {
096                PaintLogger.warnf("Processing aborted by user.");
097                break;
098            }
099
100            // Determine target experiment path (sweepDir override if given)
101            Path experimentPath = (sweepDir != null)
102                    ? sweepDir.resolve(experimentName)
103                    : projectPath.resolve(experimentName);
104
105            // Verify the directory actually exists
106            if (!Files.isDirectory(experimentPath)) {
107                PaintLogger.errorf("Experiment directory '%s' does not exist.", experimentPath);
108                continue;
109            }
110
111            // Run the TrackMate workflow for this experiment
112            try {
113                boolean ok = runTrackMateOnExperiment(
114                        experimentPath,
115                        imagesPath.resolve(experimentName),
116                        dialog);
117
118                if (!ok) {
119                    status = false;                         // Mark failure if sub-run failed
120                }
121
122            } catch (Exception e) {
123                PaintLogger.errorf("Error during TrackMate run for '%s': %s",
124                                   experimentName, e.getMessage());
125                status = false;
126            }
127        }
128
129        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
130        // Phase 4 – Report summary and duration
131        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
132        Duration totalDuration = Duration.between(start, LocalDateTime.now());
133        PaintLogger.infof("Processed %d experiments in %s.",
134                          experimentNames.size(),
135                          formatDuration((int) (totalDuration.toMillis() / 1000)));
136
137        return status;
138    }
139}
